Context: The merchants of the Dutch East India Company gave special instructions about Henry Hudson's responsibilities in a contract.
Title: Source 2: [Adapted from] a Contract between the Dutch East India Company and Henry Hudson (1609)
Content: The directors shall supply a small ship and provide men, supplies, and other necessities¹. Hudson shall sail to search for the Northwest Passage. He shall gain as much knowledge of the lands as can be done without much loss of time. If possible, he shall return immediately to make a complete report of his voyage to the directors. He will deliver his journals, log books, and charts, together with a report of everything that happens to him during the voyage.
